summary: Frontend-only testing of Smart Shower Meter Expo web app. Verified Timer (start/pause/resume/stop), persistence (>3s sessions save), History row + edit sheet (flow rate change propagates to water/cost), Analytics/Insights (period + metric segments, stat cards, bar chart), Settings (flow/cost/currency inputs + sensitivity segments), and Smart Meter screen. All primary testIDs found and functional. Currency change (currency=€) propagated to Timer cost display. No red screen / uncaught errors. Minor: React Native Web deprecation warnings for 'shadow*' style props (should migrate to 'boxShadow') and 'props.pointerEvents' (should use style.pointerEvents). Smart Meter: on headless web, microphone permission is auto-granted so screen goes directly into the 'Listening for water…' UI (waveform + Stop Listening rendered) instead of the intro Enable Microphone button — this is expected behavior for web/headless (the intro screen would render normally when permission is undetermined on a real device).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on React Native Web. Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts (shadow tokens spread into styles across screens).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a third-party component (react-native-reanimated / gesture-handler). Non-blocking but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: migrate custom shadow tokens in theme.ts to use boxShadow for web (keep RN-native shadow* for iOS/Android via Platform-specific styles) to silence deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required — all requested flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AppDataContext correctly persists to storage (AsyncStorage / IndexedDB on web). Records sorted by startedAt desc — good.
Timer only saves when duration >= 3s (matches spec).
Smart meter uses expo-audio (not deprecated expo-av) — good.
No hardcoded URLs; app is fully offline as intended.
All interactive elements have testID attributes.
seed_data_creation: One test shower session (~8s, flow=9→20) created via the UI to validate persistence, history edit, and analytics rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a fully local Expo web app at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no backend). All testIDs used in the review request work. To validate persistence, run timer for >6s before Stop. Smart Meter on headless web skips the Enable Microphone intro because permission is auto-granted; on device the intro screen will render as expected.
